description: Expanded Skippy eval set for quantization-comparison experiments. Extends v1's 12 prompts with: 24 auto-generated datasheet factual probes (pruned from 36 candidates — weak-gold ones dropped), 3 refusal prompts (match_mode='any' — correct response is a refusal, not a fabricated number), 3 multi-hop prompts, 2 numerical-precision probes. 'gold_substrings' semantics: 'all' (default) = every substring must appear case-insensitive; 'any' = at least one must appear (used for refusal-detection patterns).

prompts.prompt: What memory interface does the i.MX 93 support for external DRAM?
Which peripheral on the i.MX 93 handles UART, and what IP block routes its pins?
What Arm cores does the i.MX 93 application processor include?
In Kyle's pillar-to-pillar IVI demo, which NXP chip ran Angry Birds on the LCD?
prompts.evidence: 'Angry Birds' appears only in a demo video transcript; no chip is named near it

prompts.prompt: What have NXP-adjacent podcasts said about the sustainability argument for electric vehicles?
I have 12 apples. I give 3/4 of them to my kid. How many do I have left? Answer with just the number.
A train leaves Austin at 9am going 60 mph. Another leaves Dallas (195 miles away) at 10am going 80 mph toward Austin. At what time do they meet? Show your work briefly.
Write a concise Python function `reverse_string(s: str) -> str` that returns the reversed string. Just the function, no preamble.
Write a Python generator `fib()` that yields Fibonacci numbers forever. Just the code.
Recommend one embedded systems book and briefly say why.
prompts.quarantine_reason: empty gold_substrings; a book recommendation cannot be substring-graded

prompts.prompt: Explain in two sentences what 'mixture of experts' means in the context of large language models.
Greet me as Skippy would, in one sentence.
prompts.category_status_note: Persona is structurally incompatible with substring grading: the deployment system prompt injects 'Skippy' identity into every model (stock and FT), so substring='Skippy' doesn't differentiate FT persona transfer; voice/cadence transfer is the actual signal and is measured by eval/voice_metrics.py. These prompts are excluded from headline pass_rate computation; per-category breakdown retains them for audit visibility. Flagged 2026-05-08 as part of SK-P0-001 (REMEDIATION_PLAN.md).

repair_notes: Oracle chunks spliced for 7 prompts whose gold fact was in the corpus but not retrieved (retrieval='oracle' — this measures model comprehension, NOT end-to-end RAG). 6 prompts whose gold fact is absent from the corpus converted to hallucination probes (category='faithfulness', match_mode='any'). Weak golds tightened. See eval/repair_eval_set.py for evidence.
